terms.definition: Material used to protect a wound.
terms.example: The nurse changed the wound dressing.

terms.definition: A record of fluid intake and excretion.

terms.example: The nurse gave a structured handover.

items.title: 3 Nursing English words in 30 seconds: wound dressing, intake and output, handover #Shorts
items.caption:
• wound dressing /wuːnd ˈdresɪŋ/ = băng vết thương
• intake and output /ˈɪnteɪk ən ˈaʊtpʊt/ = lượng dịch vào và ra
• handover /ˈhændəʊvə/ = bàn giao ca
